title: Pelican Reckon
style: Comedy pop with cheeky Aussie swing, bouncy syncopated clap groove, and a punchy chantable chorus; verse rides sparse beatbox, snapped percussion, and playful bass stabs; pre-chorus strips to handclaps and stacked harmonies; chorus hits with gang vocals, bird-call synth blips, and call-and-response ad-libs. Four close-mic character vocals trade leads with doubled hook lines, Spanish licks, beatbox fills, and harmony stacks. Ear candy: reverse swells into choruses, magpie swoops as transition hits, and toy-key chirps between phrases. Bright, playful, and big-smiled mix., comedy, oi, happy, bounce
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Corey]
Corey says, easy mate, I’ve got the map
Eye to the sky, I spot the snap
Reverse that mess, flip it back
Quick as a quokka on a backyard lap

[Michelle]
Michelle goes smack, pickleball flash
Mishy Mish Mash, big grin, big splash
Pink drink thinking, what a mad little dream
One more smash and the whole crew scream

[Ruby]
Ruby in the chair with the scissors on glide
Roo roo, paint on the sleeve, spark in the eyes
Little artist hands, big boss vibe
Draws a galah with a wink and pride

[Wez]
Wez with the code, decoder mode
Wezza on the mic with a funny side-road
Bo bo, aye i i, let it roll
Found the secret in the jellybean bowl

[Pre-Chorus]
[Corey]
Aussie aussie aussie

[All]
Here aha, here

[Michelle]
Micha, Wezza, where’d you go?

[Ruby]
Off she goes, super dog speed

[Wez]
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha

[Chorus]
[All]
Pelican, that’s what we reckon
Pelican, keep it cheeky, keep it steppin’
Roo roo roo, kanga bounce
Pelican, that’s what we reckon

[Verse 2]
[Corey]
A.I. eye, eye sees all
Hawk eye up high when the shadows call
Super smart grin, but still a clown
Turns the whole weird mess inside out

[Michelle]
Michelle with the smash, no time to freeze
Pickleball popping like a breeze through trees
“¿Qué pasa?” she laughs, “todo bien”
Then she lobs one back and they all yell “again!”

[Ruby]
Ruby says “hola” with glitter on cheek
Style on the floor and a brush so sleek
Mi mini black sniffer poodle trots past
Aussie, aussie, aussie, moving fast

[Wez]
Wez decodes the joke, finds the punchline spark
Sneaky phonk panther in the backyard dark
Pelican peeks, then the whole crew shouts
One little clue and the chaos jumps out

[Bridge]
[Corey]
Hawk eye, sky eye, all seen clear

[Michelle]
Pink drink thinkin’, bring it here

[Ruby]
Roo roo, paint it, let it show

[Wez]
Wezza says, “Sí, let’s go!”

[Final Chorus]
[All]
Pelican, that’s what we reckon
Pelican, keep it cheeky, keep it steppin’
Aussie aussie aussie, here we come
Pelican, that’s what we reckon

[All]
Roo roo roo, kanga bounce
Oi oi oi, the whole block loud
Pelican, that’s what we reckon
Pelican, that’s what we reckon
